purpose: Defines the norms for exchanging transient, per-process data (requests and results) between a SKILL caller and a custom Agent so the exchange does not break regardless of data size.
summary: Scope: transient data handled by this document versus permanent documents handled by the doc access principle
Why prompts and return values should not carry full payloads: size limits, AI relay distortion, undefined shape
Pass only identifiers; scripts generate them and resolve storage locations
Scripts write the data; the AI never assembles JSON and values are stored unmodified
Readers obtain an absolute path from a script and read the file directly
Values arrive untransformed, including newlines, quotes, and non-ASCII
Definitions (SKILL.md or agent definition) own field meanings and script usage
Write only after decisions are final, with no overwrite operation
Success is expressed by an exit value string "0"; no format validation; absolute paths allowed
Delete everything held for the process afterwards; each feature decides identifiers, locations, fields, error values
tasks: Designing SKILL to custom Agent data exchange
Creating or editing a custom Agent definition
Writing a script that writes request or result files
Writing or reviewing SKILL.md that launches an Agent
Defining exit values and error value sets for a feature
Reviewing requirements or design documents for agent handoff
title: agent とのデータ受け渡し
